requests.prompt:
Create exactly ONE uninterrupted full-frame vertical 9:16 production illustration in detailed cinematic ChronoStick. Input image 1 is master rendering authority only; never copy its board layout. All surfaces are drawn with dark controlled outlines and simplified matte forms, muted ochre/umber/slate/burgundy/olive palette and soft cinematic illustrated shading. People have round off-white heads, dot eyes, very sparse brows/mouth, no realistic nose, narrow stick-derived bodies/limbs and simple pale drawn hands; detailed clothing follows that simplified skeleton, not human anatomical bodies. Standard full body about 5.0–5.8 head diameters, shoulders narrower than a head. No photorealistic inserts or painterly surface rendering. One scene, one viewpoint, one instant; exact inventory stated below. No grid, panels, border, repeated views, inset faces, typography, captions, labels, readable letters or numerals. All story-critical subjects/props within safe margins. Zero unlisted people, animals, vehicles, signs, flags, weapons or props.

Input 2 controls Fawkes, input 3 the blue-gray felt-hat lead guard, input 4 the buff-coated steel-helmet peer guard; input 5 controls undercroft stone vault, fixed barrel stacks, central floor aisle, Fawkes costume and lighting geometry. Input 6 controls the same oak door, LEFT hinges, iron latch and stone arch from the closed-door search state; open this same door instead of replacing its construction. Exactly THREE visible adult stick people at the now-open storeroom threshold. Same eye-level axis looking into the barrel-lined aisle. ONE thick oak door is swung open against the screen-left stone arch, its iron latch/hinges visible. Lead guard foreground screen left in rear three-quarter view, identity's felt hat and blue-gray coat preserved; his right hand holds ONE low iron candle lantern. Peer guard foreground screen right in rear three-quarter view, buff coat, steel-gray open-face crested helmet; exactly ONE plain polearm at the far-right edge, its point safely inside frame. Fawkes is centered in midground, front visible between guards, boots visible, half a step away from the nearest right barrel, closed mouth and alert face. Nobody is already bound or gripping him: pre-restraint discovery instant ready for one guard reach. Lead guard's free left hand rests forward at waist level ready to stop Fawkes. Keep the hand-to-sleeve route clear, faces/hat silhouettes separable and fixed left-right placement. Stationary closed barrel stacks unchanged, zero lit fuse, explosion, fire, smoke, blood, extra people or additional lanterns/weapons. Warm lower-left lantern key and cool right shadows; every person/object in the same drawn stick-world. Distinct hat/helmet/head cues and exact count must survive close crop.
